prompts.character:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: premium game-cover character cutout, a single full-body mascot, genuine transparent RGBA background.
Reference image 1 is the established Mummy Mayhem character identity and painting style; it is a visual reference, not a sheet to reproduce.
Create a polished cover illustration of this SAME adorable Egyptian mummy CAT: triangular peach-lined cat ears, turquoise and lapis blue striped pharaonic headcloth, one large luminous amber eye visible on the viewer's left, the other eye naturally covered by ivory linen, pink cat nose, cheerful open smile with one tiny fang, turquoise-and-gold collar, softly painted cream linen wrapping the whole body, rounded cat paws and feet. Keep the torso comfortably slender with a small belly, not a big round abdomen. Preserve the distinctive face and proportions from the reference.
Pose: lively, welcoming and confident, slight three-quarter stance facing the camera, one paw raised in a natural friendly wave, relaxed other arm, weight firmly over the feet. Natural elbow and shoulder anatomy. A long bandaged cat tail must visibly emerge from the rear hip and curve behind the body in a coherent attached arc. Three or four long loose linen ends flow gracefully together in the same gentle breeze, with rooted attachment points hidden plausibly in the wrappings. No detached strips or disconnected joints.
Style: high-end hand-painted 3D cartoon game key art, clean readable silhouette, beautiful cloth folds, sculpted warm ivory highlights, dimensional turquoise enamel, restrained fine detail at thumbnail scale. Warm golden key light from upper left, subtle cool turquoise rim on the right, consistent with the tomb setting.
Composition: portrait 2:3, high resolution, entire ears, raised paw, bandage ends, tail and both feet visible with a comfortable transparent margin on all sides. Character alone. Clean alpha edge including between limbs and fabric ends.
Constraints: actual transparent background, NOT a checkerboard painted into the image; no floor, no scenery, no pedestal, no ground shadow, no text, no title, no logo, no frame, no UI, no extra characters, no collage, no sprite sheet.
prompts.background:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone premium Egyptian mummy-cat game COVER BACKGROUND, widescreen 16:9 landscape, high resolution ideally 2560x1440.
Reference image 1 is the game's existing tomb environment, for world identity, sandstone/turquoise palette and polished painted style. Recompose it as finished cover key art rather than a blank game-board recess.
Scene: a richly crafted ancient Egyptian temple vault with monumental warm sandstone columns, restrained turquoise and lapis enamel inlays and gold trim, elegant cat and scarab reliefs, gently hanging cream linen, a few carefully placed braziers casting warm amber light. Include clear architectural depth, a receding stone floor, and a softly illuminated doorway or far hall, giving the space a sense of discovery. Keep the theme friendly and enchanting, not horror.
Composition: balanced cinematic wide composition, architectural details concentrated toward the outer sides and upper arch. Keep a broad, calm readable middle foreground area for a separately composited full-body mummy cat, and an uncluttered upper-middle zone where a title can later be placed. The center must still be a believable temple interior, not a giant flat rectangular black or teal game-board hole. Leave a visually quiet stone floor for the character's feet. Avoid placing focal ornaments, flames or harsh lines immediately behind a future character's face. Useful across both wide and square cover crops.
Lighting: warm golden light enters from upper left, subtle turquoise atmospheric fill on the right; clear layers of depth, soft volumetric shafts and a small amount of drifting dust, crisp detailed foreground masonry. Painted 3D cartoon finish matching the reference, premium game marketing art, saturated turquoise balanced with warm sandstone, composed highlights rather than random glowing particles.
Constraints: background only, NO live characters, NO mummy mascot, NO humanoids, NO reels, NO cards, NO wheel, NO game board, NO buttons, NO numbers, NO visible lettering, NO title, NO watermark, NO outer frame. Opaque full-bleed artwork, not transparent.
